# DSH Plugins

> A bilingual directory of popular DeepSeek Harness plugins, DSH skills, MCP tools, model adapters, productivity workflows, DevOps runtimes and themes.

- Website: https://dsh-plugin.top/
- Sitemap: https://dsh-plugin.top/sitemap.xml
- GitHub topic source: https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin
- Catalog size: 522

## Categories

- 技能 (skills): 431
- 工具 (tools): 43
- 模型适配 (model-adapters): 10
- 企业 (enterprise): 14
- 生产力 (productivity): 2
- DevOps (devops): 2
- 主题 (themes): 20

## Popular plugins

- [DeepSeek Harness Agent Framework](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/): An open-source agent harness from DeepSeek AI where models, tools, skills, sessions, and interfaces are all plugins. (104627 GitHub stars)
- [Open-Source Design Workbench](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/nexu-io/open-design/): A local-first, open-source Claude Design alternative that lets coding agents create prototypes, websites, presentations, images, and videos. (86581 GitHub stars)
- [Personality Distillation AI Skill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/titanwings/colleague-skill/): Turn the thinking patterns, expertise, and voice of colleagues, family, public figures, fictional characters, or yourself into a reusable AI Skill. (22228 GitHub stars)
- [Architecture Visualization Skill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/tt-a1i/archify/): Generate polished, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as interactive HTML. (12747 GitHub stars)
- [Self-Evolving AI Workbench](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/): A local-first visual AI workbench that turns one goal into editable code, documents, presentations, websites, designs, and videos. (4068 GitHub stars)
- [Animated Agent Pet Gallery](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/crafter-station/petdex/): A public gallery of animated companions for Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Hermes, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and other coding agents. (3814 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop/): A desktop experience that starts and manages the official DeepSeek Harness Web UI without requiring users to run terminal commands. (3626 GitHub stars)
- [Agent virtual file system](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/strukto-ai/mirage/): The World's First Unified Virtual Filesystem For AI Agents. (3431 GitHub stars)
- [Skill Router & Workflow Orchestrator](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/foryourhealth111-pixel/Vibe-Skills/): Automatically discover and route local Skills, then orchestrate them into structured, verifiable agent workflows. (2793 GitHub stars)
- [Bamboo Cicada Web Toy](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/imsai-sh/zhuzhiliao/): A mobile-first, single-file Web simulation of the traditional Chinese bamboo cicada toy, with touch, motion, and synthesized sound. (2790 GitHub stars)
- [Personalized Content Discovery Agent](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/whiteguo233/OpenBiliClaw/): A private, cross-platform content discovery agent for Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, YouTube, and other media sources. (2459 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Web UI Extension Suite](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui/): A collection of DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugins and themes for task boards, Git graphs, side panels, remote access, visual tools, pets, and token statistics. (2255 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek Harness Plugin Directory](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/): A continuously maintained directory of noteworthy plugins across the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. (2002 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek Harness Vision Bridge](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/liustack/modlens/): Add OCR, layout analysis, and semantic understanding to text-only coding agents, with structured visual evidence as output. (1527 GitHub stars)
- [Two-Phase DSH Preset](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard/): A two-phase DeepSeek Harness preset with a minimal aligned bootstrap followed by the full Standard toolset. (1346 GitHub stars)
- [AI code review tool](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/hyhmrright/brooks-lint/): AI code reviews grounded in 12 classic engineering books — decay risk diagnostics with book citations, severity labels, and 6 analysis modes including full-sweep auto-fix. (1330 GitHub stars)
- [Swift native macOS coding agent](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/paean-ai/deeptide/): Built by DeepSeek, for DeepSeek — a Swift-native macOS coding agent. (1051 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Terminal Interface](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/): A Claude Code-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness with streaming thoughts, live status, context progress, time rewind, and TPS metrics. (1049 GitHub stars)
- [Architecture Governance Assistant](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/GanyuanRan/Aegis/): Make AI coding agents architecture-aware: baseline-first, evidence-verified, drift-checked, and safe across long tasks. (1013 GitHub stars)
- [Image Upload Engine](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/PicGo/PicGo-Core/): A lightweight image-uploading engine with both command-line and API support. (972 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Sidebar Workbench](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar/): A service-based sidebar and bottom-panel workbench that lets DeepSeek Harness plugins register pages, file previews, and workspace tools. (915 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Plugin Ecosystem Radar](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins/): Automatically discovers DeepSeek Harness plugins and verifies installation evidence so users can compare working options before installing. (908 GitHub stars)
- [Agent Vision Toolkit](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Anionex/agent-vision-toolkit/): Give text-only coding agents multi-image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, frontend UI reconstruction, and GUI automation capabilities. (872 GitHub stars)
- [Agent Coding Tools MCP](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/xyTom/coding-tools-mcp/): An MCP toolkit that gives AI agents a broader set of practical coding and repository operations. (782 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Whale Theme Collection](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/): A collection of whale-themed skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. (745 GitHub stars)
- [Autonomous Coding Partner](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/hellowind777/helloagents/): A workflow layer for AI coding CLIs with skills, project knowledge, delivery checks, safer configuration writes, and resumable execution. (680 GitHub stars)
- [Pi CLI Activity Extension](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/ccch1mneyyy/working-activity/): Lively Working-line extension for pi CLI. (644 GitHub stars)
- [Open source CMA-compliant agent runtime for any model](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/): Open-source CMA-compatible agent runtime for any model, with MCP tools, sandboxed sessions, audit, replay, and a local console. (581 GitHub stars)
- [self-evolving agent system](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/nutshellai-tech/mobius/): The first self-evolving open-source Agent OS, connecting your team, AI agents, devices, and compute. (561 GitHub stars)
- [AI character interaction platform](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/yejiming/MuseAI/): Create your AI character and enter your story world. Chat with characters, go on adventures, travel through books, and let every interaction leave a bond (supports DeepSeek Harness plug-in, welcome to use). (548 GitHub stars)
